statement: The sides of triangle $T$ with vertices $(0,0)$, $(3,0)$, $(0,3)$ are mirrors. Show that one of the reflected images of triangle $T_1$ with vertices $(0,0)$, $(0,1)$, $(2,0)$ is the triangle with vertices $(24,36)$, $(24,37)$, $(26,36)$.
Let $k$ be a positive integer such that $\dfrac{k(k+1)}{3}$ is a perfect square. Show that $\dfrac{k}{3}$ and $k+1$ are both perfect squares.
A function $f$ defined on the integers satisfies $f(x) = x - 10$ if $x > 100$, and $f(x) = f(f(x+11))$ if $x \leq 100$. Determine, with justification, the set of all possible values of $f$.

Players $A$ and $B$ each have ten chips numbered $1$ to $10$. The board has two rows: row 1 with cells $1$ to $1492$, row 2 with cells $1$ to $1989$. At turn $n$, $A$ places chip $n$ in any empty cell; $B$ places chip $n$ in any empty cell of the other row. $B$ wins if after turn $10$ both rows show chip numbers in the same relative order. Which player has a winning strategy? Generalize to $k$ chips and to rows indexed by $\mathbb{Q}$ and $\mathbb{Z}$.

A tetrahedron has its circumscribed sphere's center inside it. Show that at least one of its edges has length greater than or equal to the edge length of a regular tetrahedron inscribed in the same sphere.
